notes.title: Tutorial Hotfix
notes.notes:
- Fixed an issue with the tutorial UI affecting the ability to stop eating if the cat is interrupted 
- Fixed an issue where pressing "unstuck" when in the tutorial would put the cat outside of the tutorial area
- Fixed some logic issues with general interaction
- Added the ability for the "unstuck" feature to reset some states of the cat just in case one gets stuck

notes.title: Eating and Drinking Hotfix
notes.notes: Fixed an issue where there the cat was unable to eat, drink, or open doors to houses even after becoming a level 2 pet

notes.title: Hotfix for jump stability
notes.notes: - Updated anim notifies to improve precalc jump stability

notes.title: Launch Hotfix
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Fixed bug where pause menu stopped triggering
[*] Fixed issue with bushes not being detected as cover
[*] Fixed the rate health declines during snowy weather
[*] Fixed the rate of food consumption for all pets and strays
[*] Fixed issue where instincts would not add XP to the cat and not allow you to level up 
[/list]
